source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** units may use each of Shieldbreaker, Soulless Horror and Overkill 2 times per battle rather than once, though never twice in a single battle round.

While mustering, each **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** unit gains its matching Extremis ability and its points cost rises by the listed amount. A unit that would take your army over the battle's points limit cannot be included. The Extremis abilities are:

- **[Decoy Targets](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.decoy-targets)** (**CALLIDUS ASSASSIN**, +15 points): 2 times per battle, at most once per battle round, during a Movement phase of yours, you may pick another friendly **INFANTRY** model on the battlefield and outside **Engagement Range** of all enemy units. It is **destroyed** without triggering any destroyed-model rules, and the **CALLIDUS ASSASSIN** is removed and placed again as near as possible to that spot, outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit.
- **[Esoteric Explosives](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.esoteric-explosives)** (**CULEXUS ASSASSIN**, +10 points): whenever the **[Grenades](vsdata:ability/core.explosives)** Stratagem targets this model, each D6 of 3+ rather than 4+ inflicts 1 **mortal wound**.
- **[Intraneural Biotech](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.intraneural-biotech)** (**EVERSOR ASSASSIN**, +15 points): the **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** Stratagem may target it even if that Stratagem was already used this phase; that use costs 1 CP less, and other units can still receive that Stratagem in the same phase.
- **[Micromelta Rounds](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.micromelta-rounds)** (**VINDICARE ASSASSIN**, +20 points): its exitus rifle gains **[[ANTI-MONSTER 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)** and **[[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)**.
